gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G20: BYTE-LENGTH EQUALITY IS NOT PAGE-STATE IDENTITY. Four ARB/23/3 page states have now been observed at 94393 bytes. Any reasoning of the form `same byte count, therefore same page` is unsound on this host and on this docket specifically.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G21: GRADE THE MATCH, PRE-REGISTER THE NULL. On this instrument `find_matched` is a boolean over the whole tag-stripped body while the excerpt is centred on the FIRST occurrence, so A MATCH ESTABLISHES OCCURRENCE AND NEVER LOCATION. (a) A conclusion that depends ONLY on occurrence — a positive control, a digest pair, the G18 bracket — MAY be pre-registered on a match. (b) A conclusion that depends on WHERE the literal landed MAY NOT be pre-registered on a match; it is graded at read time. Any earlier occurrence, in navigation chrome or in the body, masks every later one, so a match-branch of this kind is one-sided by construction. (c) A null branch MAY be pre-registered, because added text cannot remove an occurrence and chrome therefore cannot produce a false null. A NULL IS CHROME-SAFE, NOT SAFE. (d) Where a presence-branch is graded at read time, the licence states in advance what this project's chrome holdings for that host do and do not cover, so the exposure is on the record before the result is. NO PRESENCE-BRANCH IS PRE-REGISTERED ON A MATCH ANYWHERE IN THIS BATCH.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G21_null_residue_list_is_FOUR_sources_an: Per the 2026-08-28 close-out next step 4, binding on every null below and NOT narrowed by anything observed since. A clean find_matched:false is jointly consistent with: (i) G5, attribute-only rendering; (ii) G6, a zero-width character or undecoded entity inside the literal; (iii) <script>/<style> BLOCK DELETION — _TAG_RE strips those blocks CONTENTS INCLUDED before general tag-stripping; and (iv) NON-TEXTUAL CONTENT TYPE — excerpt_of returns empty and find_matched is false regardless of the literal. Any null row below must state all four. Residue (iv) is excluded on a row ONLY where that row's own content_type is read and found textual, and excluding it is a read-time act, not a pre-registration.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G22: PAGE-STATE INEQUALITY DOES NOT LOCALISE CHANGE. A change in sha256 or bytes DOES NOT LOCALISE THE CHANGE AND IS NOT BY ITSELF EVIDENCE THAT ANY PARTICULAR SCOPED REGION CHANGED. Corollary: a digest series is not a change-detection series for a scoped region unless the window itself is compared. This is the converse of G20 and does not weaken it.
gates_pre_registered_before_any_result_e.G23_case_insensitivity: BINDING IN BOTH DIRECTIONS per the 2026-08-28 close-out next step 4. The search is case-insensitive: body.lower().find(find.lower()). A NULL therefore establishes that no case variant of the literal occurs in the reduced body — stronger than this record has historically claimed. A MATCH correspondingly fires on ANY case variant ANYWHERE, and no row may read a match as carrying the literal's own casing.
